events.verdict: Carter (SAC) establishes himself in Fears' (NOP) path and absorbs the contact to his front at the end of Fears' drive before he passes.
Fears (NOP) releases the ball prior to his foot coming down out of bounds.
Queen (NOP) gets his hand to the ball to cleanly dislodge it from Raynaud (SAC) prior to any incidental contact occurring.
Bey (NOP) and Raynaud (SAC) briefly come together and separate after the steal.
Replay review of the foul called on Queen (NOP) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Clifford (SAC) establishes himself in Queen's (NOP) path and absorbs the contact in his chest.
Fears (NOP) makes direct contact with the ball to briefly dislodge it from Raynaud (SAC).
Murphy III (NOP) slides his hand off Raynaud's (SAC) side, and marginal contact occurs off-ball.
Murphy III (NOP) contests the shot attempt and makes marginal contact with Raynaud (SAC) after his release on his post-shot attempt.
Queen (NOP) firms up in Carter's (SAC) path in the backcourt and absorbs the contact as they come together during the pick.
Carter (SAC) makes direct contact with the ball to cleanly block Fears' (NOP) jump shot attempt.
Carter (SAC) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds. Possession correctly remains with NOP.
Clifford (SAC) trails Murphy III (NOP) when marginal contact occurs as they briefly come together and separate before the inbound pass.
Plowden (SAC) aligns alongside Bey's (NOP) path to the basket when marginal contact occurs on the driving shot attempt.
Queen (NOP) commits a take foul on Carter (SAC).
Queen (NOP) commits a take foul on Raynaud (SAC).
Cardwell (SAC) turns alongside Williamson's (NOP) path when incidental body contact occurs after Williamson's gather. Cardwell then cleanly blocks the driving shot attempt.
Bey (NOP) commits a take foul on Clifford (SAC).
Queen (NOP) and Raynaud (SAC) mutually engage and separate during the rebound.

Replay review of the foul called on Cardwell (SAC) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Cardwell (SAC) legally jumps toward the basket and makes direct contact with the ball to cleanly block the driving shot attempt prior to any incidental contact occurring.
Fears (NOP) commits a take foul on Carter (SAC).
